templates.name: Latest
templates.description: Update existing pinned Grunts to newer generally available models in the same provider, family and tier. Keeps IDs and custom settings; adds or deletes nothing.
templates.compatibility_notes: Requires a ready System Grunt and access to the configured providers. Actual model access is checked before each change.

templates.name: Balanced
templates.description: Create or update two model-specific Codex Grunts: GPT-6 Luna for everyday work and GPT-6.1 Sol for deeper work. Requires Codex access to both models.
templates.compatibility_notes: Follows verified generally available equivalents within the Luna and Sol families. Preserves existing user-created Grunts and menu preferences; never creates effort variants.
